Q: Codeigniter DB date_format A:

Judging by the year this question was posted and the parentheses around the FROM table hints that the installed CodeIgniter is likely to be version 2. I say this because version 3 had several refinements in the query builder pattern which eliminate some previously encountered breakage.

My observations are:

  1. os.group contains mysql keyword group and I don't know if it is being properly identifier quoted. See also Error 1064 at JOIN of table named "groups" in CodeIgniter query
  2. All of the aliases in the SELECT clause are single-quoted which is allowed in MySQL, but for broader validity using identifier quotes (backticks in this case) would be more ideal.
  3. For consistency, country 'Country' should have AS between the column and the alias.
  4. Before CI3, it may have been necessary to pass false as the second parameter of the select() call to explicitly disabled automated escaping/quoting.
  5. The select() line of code is very long so to improve readability, I recommend declaring a re-usable array of columns/aliases instead.
  6. Until you isolate exactly what part of your rendered SELECT clause is broken, you can explicitly disable auto-escaping and manually apply identifier quotes.
protected array $osAliases = [
    'first_name' => 'First Name',
    'last_name' => 'Last Name',
    'phone' => 'Phone',
    'group' => 'Group',
    'gender' => 'Gender',
    'birth_date' => 'DOB',
    'email' => 'Email',
    'street_address' => 'Address',
    'city' => 'City',
    'province' => 'Province',
    'postal_code' => 'Postal Code',
    'country' => 'Country',
    'payment_amount' => 'Payment Amount',
];

public function getOfflineShoppersWithNotes(): array
{
    foreach ($this->osAliases as $col => $alias) {
        $this->db->select(vsprintf(
            '%s AS %s',
            $this->db->escape_identifiers(["os.$col", $alias])
        ), false);
    }
                
    return $this->db
        ->select(vsprintf(
            '%s AS %s',
            $this->db->escape_identifiers(['an.notes', 'Notes'])
        ), false)
        ->select(vsprintf(
            "DATE_FORMAT(%s, '%%d/%%m/%%Y') AS %s",
            $this->db->escape_identifiers(['payment_date', 'Payment Date'])
        ), false)
        ->join('athlete_notes an', 'id');
        ->group_by(['first_name', 'last_name'])
        ->order_by('last_name, first_name')
        ->get('offline_shoppers os')
        ->result_array();
}
